ca976c7182b899.s: The Integrated Transport and Logistics Authority (ITLA) technically appraises central projects costing:
ca976c7182b899.x: ITLA undertakes technical appraisal of central projects of ₹500 crore or more; it also prepares a 10+ year National Transport Master Plan.

caa73b64a6cd8b.s: The National Action Plan on Climate Change (NAPCC), launched in 2008, has how many national missions?
caa73b64a6cd8b.x: The NAPCC (2008) comprises eight national missions; SAPCCs operate at the State level.

cac6b844ea0385.s: Training under Mission Rangeen Machhli–2031 is meant for:
o: Coastal fishers, youth and women SHGs
cac6b844ea0385.x: The Mission's training covers coastal fishers, youth and women self-help groups, not coastal fishers alone.

caa57666a13cde.s: Violations under Kerala's proposed comprehensive elderly care law are to be punished with:
caa57666a13cde.x: The proposed law covers abuse, neglect and illegal property occupation, mandates registration of old-age homes and provides for jail and fines.

ca19093aeb0beb.s: What is the principal cereal of Kharif crops, which are sown with the southwest monsoon?
ca19093aeb0beb.x: Kharif crops are sown with the southwest monsoon and rice is their main cereal; wheat is the main Rabi cereal.

cnee7b237b1dfd.s: The Press Council of India was first set up in 1966 under the Press Council Act of:
cnee7b237b1dfd.x: The PCI was first set up in 1966 under the Press Council Act, 1965; it can only warn, admonish or censure.

cne0c72b200d73.s: How many members does each Department-Related Standing Committee (DRSC) reconstituted for 2026-27 have?
cne0c72b200d73.x: Each DRSC has 31 members: 21 from Lok Sabha and 10 from Rajya Sabha.

cna630fee61f6a.s: Who chairs the Department-Related Standing Committee on Defence for 2026-27?
cna630fee61f6a.x: Radha Mohan Singh heads the Defence committee; Bhartruhari Mahtab heads Finance and Shashi Tharoor heads External Affairs.

cn908d7aef476a.s: Of the 24 DRSCs reconstituted in October 2026, how many work under the Lok Sabha Speaker?
cn908d7aef476a.x: 16 DRSCs work under the Lok Sabha Speaker and 8 under the Rajya Sabha Chairman.

cn455e3369822a.s: Under Telangana's new senior citizens framework, government employees neglecting their parents face a salary deduction of:
cn455e3369822a.x: A 15% salary deduction, credited to the parents, applies to government employees who neglect them.

cn8bb07e81532f.s: Which of the following is NOT correct about pharma-sector bodies?
o: The Department of Pharmaceuticals was established in 2008 under the Ministry of Chemicals and Fertilizers.
The NPPA was set up in 1997.
The NPPA fixes drug prices under DPCO-2013.
The committee on unethical pharma marketing must report within six months of its first meeting.
cn8bb07e81532f.x: The committee must report within two months of its first meeting, not six; the other statements are correct.

cn59adb6d62cc5.s: Per the NITI Aayog report of October 2026, India's 60+ population will reach how many by 2050?
cn59adb6d62cc5.x: The report projects 347 million elderly by 2050 (about 20.8%), up from 149 million in 2022.

cn4466178605c0.s: The NITI Aayog report on the elderly (October 2026) calls for training how many multi-skilled caregivers?
cn4466178605c0.x: The report calls for funds to train 1.5 lakh multi-skilled caregivers.

cnc07b1ac9ac7d.s: The High-Level Committee on Banking for Viksit Bharat, set up on 30 October 2026, must give its roadmap within:
cnc07b1ac9ac7d.x: The committee was set up on 30 October 2026 with a six-month deadline for its roadmap.

cn4dbff4e8db8c.s: The Lead Bank Scheme was introduced in:
cn4dbff4e8db8c.x: The Lead Bank Scheme dates from 1969; the RBI was established on 1 April 1935.

cn7c9d7f09b1a6.s: In which year was the National Pharmaceutical Pricing Authority (NPPA) established?
cn7c9d7f09b1a6.x: The NPPA was set up in 1997; the Department of Pharmaceuticals came in 2008.

ca633c21eb725b.s: Which of the following is NOT correct about the Constitution (129th Amendment) Bill, 2024?
o: The President notifies the appointed date.
The Election Commission notifies the appointed date.
After a mid-term dissolution, elections are held only for the unexpired term.
ca633c21eb725b.x: The appointed date is notified by the President, not the Election Commission.

ca7492787059e8.s: Under MHA rules, a new renewable-energy project within what distance of the International Border needs a Ministry of Defence NOC?
ca7492787059e8.x: Projects within 20 km of the International Border require a Ministry of Defence NOC.

ca94cff1b1dd33.s: Which of the following is NOT correct about the 2026 changes at the Ministry of Education?
o: Pralhad Joshi was given additional charge of the Ministry.
Dharmendra Pradhan resigned as Education Minister.
MHRD was renamed the Ministry of Education in 2015.
The Ministry was called the Ministry of Human Resource Development until 2020.
ca94cff1b1dd33.x: MHRD was renamed the Ministry of Education in 2020, not 2015.

ca228b815826fe.s: NITI Aayog's Ayurveda roadmap identifies which system as Ayurveda's main global competitor?
ca228b815826fe.x: Traditional Chinese Medicine is identified as Ayurveda's main competitor; Unani is still part of the Ministry of AYUSH.

ca26be7c317aeb.s: Who chairs the Supreme Court committee on the SJP protests over NEET and police action?
ca26be7c317aeb.x: The five-member committee is chaired by Justice R. Subhash Reddy; Justice R.K. Jha is a member.

ca52543a9a2f06.s: Which of the following is NOT correct about the notified-disaster framework for 2026–2031?
o: The MHA is the nodal ministry for the Disaster Management Act, 2005.
The SDRF is the main State fund, with Centre and State contributions.
The NDRF gives additional aid for disasters of severe nature.
The notified calamities rose from 12 to 13.
ca52543a9a2f06.x: Heatwave and lightning were both added, so the list rose from 12 to 14, not 13.

cae1e860838c1d.s: Which of the following communities is among the six notified minorities under the National Commission for Minorities?
cae1e860838c1d.x: The six notified minorities are Muslims, Christians, Sikhs, Buddhists, Parsis and Jains.

cab62e412de7c6.s: In NITI Aayog's Strategic Roadmap for Making Ayurveda Global, modernising the TKDL falls in which phase?
cab62e412de7c6.x: Modernising TKDL and Medical Value Travel hubs are medium-term measures; the Global Ayurveda Register is short-term.

ca97a366e40dbe.s: In Telangana's cyber campaign 'Suraksha Ka Tiranga', the colour green stood for:
ca97a366e40dbe.x: Saffron stood for 'Be Alert', white for 'Be Aware' and green for 'Be Safe'.

ca0910d58f1cf0.s: Samadhan Didi, the first AI voice chatbot for CPGRAMS, supports how many Eighth Schedule languages?
ca0910d58f1cf0.x: Samadhan Didi, developed by DARPG with Bhashini, supports all 22 Eighth Schedule languages.

cabc29a70df0bb.s: The K.G. Balakrishnan Commission (October 2022) examines extending SC status to Dalits converted to:
cabc29a70df0bb.x: The Commission examines SC status for Dalits who converted to Christianity and Islam.

ca059f118327ac.s: Who heads the Lok Sabha Estimates Committee for 2026–27?
ca059f118327ac.x: Dr. Sanjay Jaiswal heads the Estimates Committee; K.C. Venugopal heads the PAC.

caefeba445cecf.x: Article 15(1) bars the State from discriminating against citizens; descent is not one of its listed grounds.

ca981062970cd1.s: How much did the Electronics Component Manufacturing Scheme receive in Budget 2026–27?
ca981062970cd1.x: ECMS was allotted ₹40,000 crore in Budget 2026–27; NITI Aayog has partnered Tata Electronics on electronics manufacturing.

ca1b9a37672852.s: Which State did not participate in the Panchayat Advancement Index (PAI) 2.0?
ca1b9a37672852.x: West Bengal stayed out of PAI 2.0, while Tripura was the top State and Uttar Pradesh had the highest participation.

caa723058b1d39.s: The vector of the paddy dwarfing disease reported in Punjab is the:
caa723058b1d39.x: The disease, caused by SRBSDV, is spread by the white-backed plant hopper and was first reported in Punjab in 2022.

ca92545b8cf8ac.s: Which of the following is NOT correct about the BCCI?
o: It is substantially controlled and financed by the government.
It is a private society under the Tamil Nadu Societies Registration Act, 1975.
Zee Telefilms v. Union of India (2005) held it not to be 'State' under Article 12.
The CIC held in May 2026 that it is not a public authority under the RTI Act.
ca92545b8cf8ac.x: The BCCI is a private society not substantially controlled or financed by the government.

caeb416e8f2f72.s: As per NCRB Crime in India 2023, how many of the 180 cases of denial of access to public spaces to SCs were from Uttar Pradesh?
caeb416e8f2f72.x: Uttar Pradesh accounted for 173 of the 180 cases in 2023.

ca2abfd8ba0db3.s: Which Directive Principle Article concerns the organisation of village panchayats?
ca2abfd8ba0db3.x: Article 40 concerns organising village panchayats; Part IX and the 11th Schedule came from the 73rd Amendment.

ca0242cedb633a.s: The CCEA extended the SARTHAK-PDS Central Scheme until:
ca0242cedb633a.x: SARTHAK-PDS was extended to March 2031 with an outlay of ₹25,530 crore.

ca57334c893073.s: What does the FCRA Amendment Bill, 2026 do to restrictions on persons in news production and broadcasting?
ca57334c893073.x: The Bill expands, not removes, restrictions on persons in news production and broadcasting.

ca9dc01b143417.s: Article 17, which abolishes untouchability, is part of which Fundamental Right?
ca9dc01b143417.x: Article 17 is part of the Right to Equality (Articles 14–18), not the Right to Freedom.

ca5f8f42032fb4.s: The NCBC received constitutional status under Article 338B through which Amendment?
ca5f8f42032fb4.x: The NCBC became statutory in 1993 and constitutional in 2018 under Article 338B (102nd Amendment).

cabe41d8089eff.s: The domicile requirement for Rajya Sabha membership was removed in:
cabe41d8089eff.x: The domicile requirement was removed in 2003; vertical devolution is formally 41%.

caf1e519713c48.s: Plague spreads to humans mainly through:
caf1e519713c48.x: Plague spreads through fleas on rodents; Nipah via bats, pigs and fruit; brucellosis via cattle and milk; rabies via dogs and bats.

new.s: Who chairs the Joint Parliamentary Committee on the Viksit Bharat Shiksha Adhishthan Bill, 2025?
new.x: The 31-member JPC on the VBSA Bill is chaired by D. Purandeswari; Sanjay Jaiswal chairs the FCRA JPC.

new.s: How many members does the JPC on the One Nation One Election (129th Amendment) Bill have?
new.x: The ONOE JPC under P.P. Chaudhary has 39 members: 27 Lok Sabha and 12 Rajya Sabha.

new.s: Which MP chaired the JPCs on both the FCRA Amendment Bill, 2026 and the Biological Diversity Amendment Bill, 2021?
new.x: Sanjay Jaiswal chaired both JPCs; P.P. Chaudhary chaired the ONOE and Personal Data Protection JPCs.

new.s: Which of the following pairs (Bill – JPC chair) is correctly matched?
o: Corporate Laws Amendment Bill, 2026 – Jagdambika Pal
Personal Data Protection Bill, 2019 – Bhupender Yadav
Multi-State Cooperative Societies (Amendment) Bill, 2022 – Rajendra Agrawal
new.x: Aparajita Sarangi chairs the 130th Amendment JPC; the Corporate Laws, PDP and Multi-State Cooperative JPCs were chaired by Sudheer Gupta, P.P. Chaudhary and C.P. Joshi.

new.s: Which Article of the Constitution lets each House of Parliament make its own rules of procedure?
new.x: Article 118 empowers each House to make its own rules of procedure.

new.s: What is the tenure of a Departmentally-Related Standing Committee (DRSC)?
new.x: DRSCs are standing committees with tenure up to one year; a JPC is ad hoc and ends after its task.

new.s: Which of the following is NOT correct about the DRSCs reconstituted for 2026-27?
o: Ministers can be members of these committees.
They examine Demands for Grants, bills and annual reports.
Eight of them work under the Rajya Sabha Chairman.
new.x: Ministers cannot be members of DRSCs.

new.s: Who chairs the Department-Related Standing Committee on Finance for 2026-27?
new.x: Bhartruhari Mahtab heads Finance; Shashi Tharoor heads External Affairs and Radha Mohan Singh heads Defence.

new.s:
Consider the following statements about parliamentary committees:
1. A Joint Parliamentary Committee is ad hoc and ends after its task.
2. A Departmentally-Related Standing Committee is a standing committee with tenure up to one year.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
new.x: Both are correct: a JPC is ad hoc, while a DRSC is a standing committee with tenure up to one year.

new.s:
Consider the following statements about the RoDTEP scheme:
1. It is notified by the Department of Commerce through DGFT.
2. It is implemented by the Department of Revenue through CBIC.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
new.x: Both are correct: DGFT notifies RoDTEP and CBIC implements it, not the other way round.

new.s: RoDTEP, in force from 1 January 2021, replaced which export scheme?
new.x: RoDTEP replaced MEIS, which faced WTO objections; RoDTEP is WTO-compliant.

new.s: The Digital Communications Commission was earlier the Telecom Commission, set up in:
new.x: The Telecom Commission was set up in 1989 and renamed DCC in 2018; it was abolished after 37 years.

new.s: After the DCC was abolished, telecom projects of ₹500–1,000 crore now go to the:
new.x: Projects of ₹500–1,000 crore go to the Expenditure Finance Committee; the Telecom Secretary approves up to ₹100 crore and the Minister up to ₹500 crore.

new.s: The 23rd Law Commission of India is which kind of body?
new.x: The Law Commission is an executive body, neither constitutional nor statutory, advising the Ministry of Law and Justice.

new.s: Who is the full-time chairperson of the 23rd Law Commission?
new.x: Justice Dinesh Maheshwari has been full-time chair since 15 April 2025; the term runs to 31 August 2027.

new.s: The current mandate of the 23rd Law Commission includes examining:
new.x: The 23rd Law Commission's mandate includes examining a Uniform Civil Code; its recommendations are not binding.

new.s: The 16th Finance Commission kept the States' share of the divisible pool at:
new.x: The 16th FC kept vertical devolution at 41%, the same as the 15th FC, and declined demands for 50%.

new.s:
Consider the following statements about the 16th Finance Commission award:
1. It keeps the States' share of the divisible pool at 41%.
2. It raises the weight of income distance to 45%.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
new.x: Statement 1 is correct. Statement 2 is wrong: income distance was cut to 42.5% from 45%.

new.s: Which criterion was newly introduced by the 16th Finance Commission for sharing taxes among States?
new.x: Contribution to GDP is the new criterion; the other three were already used and only had their weights changed.

new.s: Who chairs the 16th Finance Commission?
new.x: Arvind Panagariya chairs the 16th FC, a constitutional body under Article 280, with an award period 2026-27 to 2030-31.

new.s: Who has been the Chairperson of the Press Council of India since 24 April 2026?
new.x: Former SC judge Justice Ranjana Prakash Desai has chaired the PCI since 24 April 2026 for three years.

new.s: Which of the following is NOT correct about the Press Council of India?
o: It is a statutory, autonomous and quasi-judicial body.
It is headquartered in New Delhi.
It has a Chairperson and 28 members.
It is a constitutional body created under Article 19(1)(a).
new.x: The PCI is statutory, under the Press Council Act, 1978; Article 19(1)(a) only guarantees press freedom.

new.s:
Consider the following statements about the Press Council of India:
1. It has 13 journalist members among its 28 members.
2. It has 5 Members of Parliament: 3 from Lok Sabha and 2 from Rajya Sabha.
3. National Press Day is observed on 16 November.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
new.x: All three are correct: the PCI has 13 journalists, 6 owners, 5 MPs, 3 institutional nominees and 1 news agency member; National Press Day is 16 November.

new.s: The Telangana Senior Citizens Commission has one Chief Commissioner and how many Commissioners?
new.x: The Commission has 1 Chief Commissioner (Justice E. Tirumala Devi) and 2 Commissioners.

new.s: Suresh N. Patel, Chairman of the High-Level Committee on Banking for Viksit Bharat, is a former:
o: MD and CEO of Indian Bank
new.x: Suresh N. Patel is a former CVC, not an RBI official.

new.s: Which serving RBI Deputy Governor is a member of the High-Level Committee on Banking for Viksit Bharat?
new.x: Shirish Chandra Murmu (RBI Deputy Governor) is a member; N.S. Vishwanathan is a former Deputy Governor.

new.s: The committee to curb unethical marketing in the pharma sector (October 2026) was constituted by the:
o: Ministry of Health and Family Welfare
new.x: It was set up by the Department of Pharmaceuticals (Ministry of Chemicals and Fertilizers) and is headed by NITI Aayog Member M. Srinivas.

new.s: Which code guides ethical marketing practices in the pharmaceutical sector?
new.x: The Uniform Code for Pharmaceutical Marketing Practices, 2024 guides ethical marketing; DPCO-2013 governs prices.

new.s: The Hockey India League, launched in 2013, was revived in which year after a seven-year break?
new.x: HIL began in 2013 and was revived in 2024 after a seven-year break.

new.s: NCRB's Crime in India 2024 (May 2026) is the first full-year data under which law?
new.x: Crime in India 2024 is the first full-year data under the BNS, 2023.

new.s: As per NCRB Crime in India 2024, cybercrime rose by about:
new.x: Cybercrime rose about 17.9%, while total cognisable crime fell about 6%.

new.s: The Periodic Labour Force Survey (PLFS) is conducted by:
new.x: PLFS is by the NSO under MoSPI; NFHS is coordinated by IIPS Mumbai.

new.s: Which body alone coordinated NFHS-6 (2023-24) for the first time?
new.x: NFHS-6, by the Health Ministry, was the first round coordinated solely by IIPS Mumbai.

new.s: Which of the following pairs (survey – conducting agency) is correctly matched?
new.x: ASER is by Pratham, an NGO; PLFS is by NSO (MoSPI) and NFHS-6 by the Health Ministry through IIPS Mumbai.

new.s: As per the PLFS bulletin for September 2026, the overall unemployment rate (15+, CWS) was:
new.x: Unemployment was 5.0% (rural 4.2%, urban 6.9%); it was 5.2% in September 2025.

new.s: Which State topped NITI Aayog's first Investment Friendliness Index (2026)?
new.x: Gujarat topped IFI 2026 with 56.6, followed by Maharashtra, Tamil Nadu, Goa and Odisha.

new.s: In NITI Aayog's Investment Friendliness Index 2026, Andhra Pradesh was placed in which category?
new.x: AP ranked 8th (48.7) and was a Frontrunner, not a Top Performer.

new.s: Which State topped NITI Aayog's Fiscal Health Index 2026 for the second year?
new.x: Odisha topped the Fiscal Health Index 2026 again; Punjab came last.

new.s: The 2026-27 foodgrain target of 373.93 MT is lower than the 2025-26 record of:
new.x: The 2026-27 target (373.93 MT) is slightly lower than the 2025-26 record of 376.56 MT.

new.s: Which body does NITI Aayog's October 2026 report on the care economy recommend setting up?
new.x: The report recommends a National Care Council, a National Care Qualification Framework and a National Caregiver Registry.

new.s: How many river links did the National Perspective Plan (1980) identify?
new.x: The NPP (1980) identified 30 links: 14 Himalayan and 16 Peninsular; NWDA came in 1982.

new.s: National Waterway-2 (Dhubri–Sadiya) on the Brahmaputra is how long?
new.x: NW-2 runs 891 km from Dhubri to Sadiya and is managed by IWAI.

new.s: Who flagged off the first post-Independence international cargo voyage from Bogibeel on 5 October 2026?
new.x: Sarbananda Sonowal flagged it off from Bogibeel Terminal, Dibrugarh; it carried methanol from APCL Namrup.

new.s: Which Law Commission report (1999) supported simultaneous elections?
new.x: The Law Commission's 170th Report (1999), under Justice B.P. Jeevan Reddy, supported simultaneous elections.

new.s: The Law Commission's 170th Report (1999) on simultaneous elections was given under Justice:
new.x: Justice B.P. Jeevan Reddy headed the Law Commission that gave the 170th Report.

new.s: The Kovind High-Level Committee recommended local body elections within how many days of the simultaneous polls?
new.x: The Kovind Committee (2023-24) recommended a phased model with local body polls within 100 days.

new.s: Which Constitution Amendment Bill, proposing 850 Lok Sabha seats, was defeated?
new.x: The 131st Amendment Bill (850 seats) was defeated; the 129th is the ONOE Bill.

new.s: The 'constructive no-confidence motion' suggested in the 2018 Law Commission draft is borrowed from:
new.x: The constructive no-confidence motion is borrowed from Germany.

new.s:
Consider the following statements about the Constitution (129th Amendment) Bill, 2024:
1. It inserts Article 82A.
2. It amends Articles 83 and 172.
3. It covers elections to local bodies.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
new.x: Statements 1 and 2 are correct. Statement 3 is wrong: local bodies are excluded from the Bill.

new.s: The award period of the 16th Finance Commission is:
new.x: The 16th FC, chaired by Arvind Panagariya, covers 2026-27 to 2030-31.

new.s: The Finance Commission is a constitutional body under Article:
new.x: The Finance Commission is constituted under Article 280; Article 148 deals with the CAG.

new.s: As per Prison Statistics India 2024, the national prison occupancy rate was:
new.x: Occupancy was 112.7%, a decade-low; Delhi had the highest at 194.6%.

new.s: Which of the following is NOT correct about Prison Statistics India 2024?
o: The occupancy rate of 112.7% was a decade-low.
Uttar Pradesh recorded the highest occupancy rate.
new.x: Delhi, at 194.6%, recorded the highest occupancy, not Uttar Pradesh.

new.s: The PLFS monthly bulletin is released by:
new.x: PLFS is released by the National Statistics Office under MoSPI.

new.s: As per the PLFS July 2026 bulletin, the overall unemployment rate (15+) was:
new.x: UR fell to 5.1% from 5.5% in June; rural UR was 4.5% and urban about 6.7%.

new.s: Which Telangana-used portal recorded 89.41% content-takedown success in the PRAGATI cybercrime review?
new.x: Sahyog recorded 89.41% takedown success; Samanvaya resolved 96.68% of inter-State requests.

new.s: The CAG holds office for six years or until the age of:
new.x: The CAG (Article 148) is appointed by the President for 6 years or until 65 years of age.

new.s: The National Commission for Minorities is a:
o: Executive body set up by a Cabinet resolution
Statutory body under the NCM Act, 1992
new.x: The NCM is statutory under the NCM Act, 1992; the NCST is constitutional under Article 338A.

new.s: Which of the following pairs (body – nature) is INCORRECTLY matched?
new.x: The Law Commission is an executive body, neither constitutional nor statutory; the other pairs are correct.

new.s: Who was appointed Chairperson of the Supreme Court Legal Services Committee in 2026?
new.x: CJI Surya Kant appointed Justice B.V. Nagarathna, succeeding Justice J.K. Maheshwari.

new.s: Who chairs the National Commission for Women?
new.x: Vijaya Rahatkar chairs the NCW, a statutory body under the NCW Act, 1990.

new.s: Who launched AppCOMS 2.0 as Chief Information Commissioner?
new.x: CIC Raj Kumar Goyal launched AppCOMS 2.0, upgrading the original AppCOMS of 2016.

new.s: SEBI's expert working group on debenture trustees (June 2026) is chaired by:
new.x: Former SEBI WTM Ananta Barua chairs it; former SBI Chairman Rajnish Kumar is co-chair.

new.s:
Consider the following statements about SEBI's expert working group on debenture trustees (June 2026):
1. It is chaired by former SEBI Whole Time Member Ananta Barua.
2. Former SBI Chairman Rajnish Kumar is its co-chair.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
new.x: Both are correct; the group reviews the SEBI (Debenture Trustees) Regulations, 1993, including net-worth requirements.

new.s: The PM Research Chair scheme of the Ministry of Education covers how many priority sectors?
new.x: PMRC targets Indian-origin researchers in 13 priority sectors; its Empowered Committee is chaired by PSA Ajay Kumar Sood.

new.s: Under MHA rules, the 50 km zone from the LoC, LAC or IB requires renewable-energy projects to get:
o: A Ministry of Defence NOC only
new.x: The 50 km zone needs prior security clearance; the ban applies only within 1 km and the MoD NOC within 20 km of the IB.

new.s: Operation Shiva 2026 of the Indian Army was conducted for the security of:
new.x: Operation Shiva secured the Amarnath Yatra 2026, using counter-drone and EW systems for the first time.

new.s: Ayurveda and herbal exports reached what value in 2023?
new.x: Exports rose from USD 1.09 bn (2014) to USD 2.16 bn (2023).

new.s: Under the Ayurveda roadmap, the Mission Steering Group is chaired by the:
new.x: The short-term Mission Steering Group is chaired by the Minister of Ayush.

new.s: Sarvam AI, the first full-stack indigenous AI unicorn, is India's which unicorn?
new.x: Sarvam AI became India's 130th unicorn and the 5th of 2026.

new.s: The Jago AI Assistant on ST welfare schemes was launched by the:
o: Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment
new.x: Jago AI Assistant is by the Ministry of Tribal Affairs, in English and Hindi.

new.s: India's first indigenous African Swine Fever vaccine was developed by:
new.x: The MA-104 cell-line vaccine was developed by ICAR-NIHSAD, Bhopal; ASF does not infect humans.

new.s: Who chairs the Education to Employment and Enterprise Standing Committee?
new.x: NITI Aayog CEO Nidhi Chhibber chairs it; its first meeting was on 22 May 2026.

new.s: Within what period must the High-Level Committee on demographic change submit its report?
new.x: The report is due within 1 year, extendable by 6 months.

new.s: Under Article 341, the list of Scheduled Castes can be modified only by:
new.x: The President notifies the SC list after consulting the Governor, but only Parliament can change it.

new.s:
Consider the following statements about the Constitution (Scheduled Castes) Order, 1950:
1. It originally covered Hindus only.
2. It was extended to Sikhs in 1956.
3. It was extended to Christians in 1990.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
new.x: Statements 1 and 2 are correct. Statement 3 is wrong: the 1990 extension was to Buddhists; Christians and Muslims are not included.

new.s: The K.G. Balakrishnan Commission was notified by which ministry?
o: Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment
new.x: The Commission of Inquiry was notified by the Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment.

new.s: The Lok Sabha Estimates Committee for 2026-27 has how many members?
new.x: The Estimates Committee has 30 members, all from Lok Sabha; PAC and COPU have 22 (15 + 7).

new.s: Which of the following pairs (committee – members) is correctly matched?
o: Committee on Public Undertakings – 30, Lok Sabha only
Welfare of SCs and STs – 22 (15 LS + 7 RS)
new.x: PAC and COPU have 22 (15 + 7); the Estimates Committee has 30 from Lok Sabha only; the SC/ST Welfare Committee has 30 (20 + 10).

new.s: Who chairs the Lok Sabha Committee on Privileges, the first under the 18th Lok Sabha?
new.x: Ravi Shankar Prasad chairs the Committee on Privileges with 14 other MPs.

new.s: Who assumed office as Chairperson of the NCBC on 27 March 2026?
new.x: Sadhvi Niranjan Jyoti replaced Hans Raj Gangaram Ahir as NCBC Chairperson.

new.s: Who was appointed Vice-Chairperson of NITI Aayog in April 2026?
